description: Feasible mounting and support hardware for the pipe, duct and device sizes found in the Zenodo DuplexModel+MEP discipline models. Values are only those found in the cited sources. max_support_spacing is null on every product because none of the cited product pages publish a support spacing for that article; spacing lives in guidance.

guidance.title: Horizontal support spacing for copper and stainless tube, as cited from DIN 1988 Teil 2
guidance.notes: Both catalogues print this as Richtwerte for copper and stainless tube and attribute it to DIN 1988 Teil 2. The standard text was not read for this database. The column copied here is straight length (Stangenrohr). The same IBP table gives shorter distances for copper coil (Ringrohr), for example 0.7–0.9 m at 15 mm, and those are not applied. No vertical-stack column is in this table. A row is offered for a modeled pipe only when the outside diameter is within 0.5 mm of a listed value, and only with the explicit assumption that the unnamed IFC material is the copper or stainless tube the table is about.

guidance.title: EN 12236 strength requirements for duct supports
guidance.notes: DIN EN 12236:2002 (EN 12236:2002) specifies strength of supports for sheet-metal ductwork of any shape. It does not publish a spacing table. From the preview of the EN text: the fixing into the structure needs a safety factor of at least 3 on the calculated load; vertical members and the joint to the horizontal member need a safety factor of at least 1.5 against yield; horizontal-member deflection must not exceed 0.4 % of the distance between the vertical fixings. Fire loading is outside the standard's scope. No spacing number is derived from it here.
